parts.title: Touch This Plant and It Folds Up! Is It SHY? (Part 1) | What Living Things Can Do
parts.description:
Touch one leaf of a mimosa plant and it folds up. Is it shy? Part 1 of Primary 3 Science, Diversity: what living things can do.

In this part:
• Living things respond to changes
• Be the mimosa: shrink down and feel the leaves fold
• A plant that turns towards the sunlight

Key words: mimosa, respond to changes.
Watch Part 2 to find out if every egg hatches on Day 21!

TheOneApp, Explained: Singapore primary science, made fun. Play along with Pip, Basil and Momo: point to lock in, keep score on your hand, beat the Buddies! Practise this topic in TheOneApp.

Singapore Primary 3 Science (2023 syllabus): Diversity of living and non-living things, what living things can do (Chapter 1, pp. 14–18). Also fits US NGSS 3-LS1-1.
Try it for real: find a mimosa ("sensitive plant") on a grass patch. One finger, one leaf; never pull the plant; wash your hands. If you look at a small animal, look and do not pick it up; an adult helps.

parts.title: 5 Eggs, 21 Days. Will EVERY Egg Hatch? (Part 2) | What Living Things Can Do
parts.description:
Five eggs, 21 days, one hen house. Will every egg hatch? Part 2 of Primary 3 Science, Diversity: what living things can do.

In this part:
• Living things reproduce
• Seeds and spores
• Extinct: when none of a kind are left
• Living things grow

Key words: reproduce, spores, extinct, more complex.
Watch Part 1 first!
